title: Incorruptible gets a Spanish edition — Deusto publishes 'Incorruptibles' on 25 November, translated by Eva Morón
summary: Deusto, the business imprint of Grupo Planeta, publishes the Spanish translation as Incorruptibles on 25 November 2026: 464 pages, translated by Eva Morón, in paperback and ebook. The cover carries its own design rather than the English one — the title repeated down the jacket and degrading line by line — under the subtitle 'por qué las buenas empresas desaparecen y las excelentes siguen creciendo'. Grupo Planeta is the largest Spanish-language publishing group, and the timeline already carries readers reacting to the book in Spanish from Buenos Aires, Madrid and Colombia; this is the edition they will be able to buy in translation.
blockquote: En su nuevo libro, el autor bestseller Eric Ries analiza por qué las empresas pierden el rumbo al crecer y propone un modelo para crear organizaciones resilientes, éticas y sostenibles. Con ejemplos reales y herramientas prácticas, ofrece una hoja de ruta para equilibrar innovación, crecimiento y propósito.
